questions.title: What is Talent Scout and how does it work?
questions.content: Every contract request is reviewed through the administration portal before it reaches the talent, to ensure transparency and reliability.

questions.title: How can I get work through it?
questions.content: Create an account, complete your profile, apply for suitable opportunities, and wait for approval.

questions.title: How will I receive my payments?
questions.content: Payments are transferred to the registered bank account within 30 business days after the project ends.

questions.title: What kind of support do you provide?
questions.content: We provide temporary hiring support, technical support for talents, and contract follow-up.
